_about: Edit decision list for the 'Biggest breathwork lesson' reel. Every time here is in SOURCE seconds (source.mp4), except tail/end_card durations. Read by tmp/bbl_edit.py; see resources/docs/content-production.md.
_face: Face centre in the 1620x1080 source. Every crop and push-in is anchored here.
_grade: Applied to the source before reframing. saturation <1 pulls the bright bamboo toward the warm-earth palette; warmth is a 0-1 blend toward brand umber.
_holds: Natural pauses that are lengthened. The window must sit inside a silence: video plays through it slowed, audio is filled with the pause's own room tone.

holds._note: after 'avoiding the feeling itself' -> into Bali
after 'come back into my body' -- the realisation

_tail: After the last word: crossfade to a closed-mouth frame, hold, fade to warm black, then the end card.
_shots: Each shot runs until the next one starts (a cut). zoom 1.0 = full-height 9:16 crop; zoom eases from[0] to [1] over the shot. dx shifts the crop sideways in source px (+ puts the face left of centre). Cuts sit in pauses.

shots._note: opening -- slow push as the idea develops
Bali -- one long, slow push, no cuts
people-pleasing -- wide, room for the message bubbles

_start_screen: Title over the live opening (he is already speaking). Replaces the caption for the words it covers. |bars| mark the sage-italic turn.
_messages: Abstract message bubbles for the people-pleasing example. No real text -- placeholder bars only.
_broll: Optional cutaways. Drop a clip in broll/ and add an entry: {"file": "broll/bali.mp4", "at": 49.0, "dur": 4.0, "in": 0.0}. 'at' is source time; his voice keeps running underneath. Leave empty to stay on the talking head.

_broll_suggestions._note: real Bali retreat footage, if you have it (only genuine footage)
you making / holding your morning coffee

_music: track: null uses the original generated score (tmp/biggest-lesson-music.wav). Set a path (relative to this folder) to use your own licensed track instead. gain_db shifts the bed; duck_db is how far it dips under your voice.
_audio: Voice loudness target and how hard the denoiser may work (dB). Higher denoise = cleaner but less natural.
